description: Patches a local project to use the Gamealia SDK, after gamealia_analyze_project: adds the SDK script tag (or import) and a lifecycle adapter, swaps CrazyGames/Poki SDKs for the Gamealia shims, adds the Unity .jslib / Godot addon. Deterministic and idempotent. Dry run by default (returns a unified diff, changes nothing); write:true edits the project's files. Returns TODOs (file:line) for the calls only you can place: gameplayStart/Stop, happyTime and ad breaks; then run gamealia_check_integration.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

write.description: Apply the patch (default: dry run, diff only)

name: gamealia_integrate_sdk
title: Integrate the Gamealia SDK
